[[File:Portrait garron.jpg|140px|left|link=House Stormrider]]
'''[[House Stormrider]]''' despises the lone hero and celebrates the thousand that move as one. Its seat, [[the Hub]], has no wall — only roads — and stands on the old battlefield itself. Its uniter, [[Garron, the Binder]], bound three generations of division together. He is genuinely loved. He is dying.
